annotations.title: Audit Contract Risks & Generate Legal Redlines

description: Audit commercial and B2B legal agreements (MSAs, NDAs, SaaS terms, subcontracts) to detect high-risk clauses, compute a 0-100 overall risk score, and generate verbatim clause quotes paired with ready-to-paste fallback redline language. This operation is read-only, stateless, and non-destructive (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `raw_text` accepts 50 to 100,000 characters, and `party_perspective` shifts redline rewrites to protect the 'vendor', 'buyer', or 'neutral' counsel). Use this tool when reviewing commercial/legal terms (indemnification, liability caps, IP ownership, termination for convenience); use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead for federal FAR/DFARS/CMMC regulatory flow-down audits, or `parse_b2b_contract` for basic metadata extraction.

focus_categories.description: Optional list of specific clause risk categories to prioritize during the audit.

party_perspective.description: Negotiating party perspective ('vendor' protects service provider liability/IP, 'buyer' strengthens customer remedies/SLAs, 'neutral' balances mutual terms).

raw_text.description: Full or partial legal contract text (MSA, NDA, subcontract, or SaaS agreement) to audit for commercial, IP, indemnification, and termination risks (50 to 100,000 characters).

name: audit_contract_risks

contract_type.description: Identified legal document type (e.g., 'Master Services Agreement', 'Mutual NDA', 'Statement of Work').

executive_summary.description: High-level deal-desk summary of the contract's risk posture and primary negotiation blockers.

flagged_clauses.description: Detailed list of risky clauses identified in the contract, ordered by severity.

missing_standard_protections.description: List of standard protective clauses missing from the contract (e.g., 'No Limitation of Liability cap').

overall_risk_score.description: Quantified overall risk score from 0 (minimal risk) to 100 (critical/unacceptable exposure).

party_perspective.description: The negotiating perspective used to evaluate risks ('vendor', 'buyer', or 'neutral').

title: Audit Contract Risks & Generate Legal Redlines
